feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 19 May 2026 7:45am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 19 May 2026 at 7:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure west of Ireland, moving eastwards, with associated fronts and troughs crossing the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South or southeast 5 or 6, veering south or southwest this afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Mostly moderate, but occasionally rough in southern and central parts of the area this evening.


##Weather##

Rain and drizzle soon clearing to scattered showers this morning, these becoming isolated during the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in precipitation.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 5 or 6, soon decreasing 4 or 5, but still occasional 6 in the south of the area.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers. Outbreaks of rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate.
